title: All Star Western Theatre
paragraphs: A Western variety program combining short frontier dramas, comedy, music by Foy Willing and the Riders of the Purple Sage, and appearances by Western film personalities.

Half-hour Western variety combining short dramas/comedy, Western music by Foy Willing and the Riders of the Purple Sage, and rotating film/radio guest stars. Surviving material also includes syndicated transcriptions.

GRH documents the program through CBS Pacific / KNX era (August 11, 1946 to February 14, 1948) on [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]] and Don Lee / Mutual / KHJ era (February 21, 1948 to August 14, 1948) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Foy Willing and The Riders Of The Purple Sage (performer on 85 recordings), Cottonseed Clark (announcer on 51 recordings and performer on 1 recording), Terry O'Sullivan (announcer on 32 recordings), Harry Lang (performer on 8 recordings), Monty Montana (performer on 8 recordings and guest on 1 recording), Joe Forte (performer on 5 recordings), and Don Diamond (performer on 4 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.7027e8a3676e0d84|KNX]] (aircheck from station), [[org|org.50630574777d6937|Don Lee Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.87e6f64937f0bfb8|KHJ]] (aircheck from station), and [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Western music and cowboy songs, frontier West, ranching and cowboy life, rodeo and horsemanship, outlaws and frontier crime, and Western film-star culture.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Postwar Western film/radio star crossover, Network airchecks and syndicated transcription afterlife, and Regional sponsor-driven Western variety.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (25 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (16 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (15 shared credited people), [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (15 shared credited people), and [[show|wild-bill-hickok|Wild Bill Hickok]] (15 shared credited people).
